description: Provider-agnostic abstract model routing policy and tier mappings

fast.description: High-throughput, low-latency model for simple fixes, typos, formatting, and doc updates

standard.description: Balanced reasoning and code generation for normal features, CRUD, and unit test authoring

strong.description: Deep architectural reasoning, planning, complex refactoring, and multi-module coordination

critical.description: Highest rigor for security vulnerabilities, cryptographic protocols, root-cause debugging of hard failures

escalationRules.onTaskRetry: Promote tier by 1 level if task previously failed (e.g. standard -> strong)
escalationRules.onSecuritySensitive: Promote to critical tier if task modifies auth, encryption, or permissions
escalationRules.onHighUncertainty: Promote to strong if decision confidence < 0.75
